name: [🎊MEGA UPDATE] "BA" Brazilian Army
desc:
⚡ On Roblox, did you know you can join the Brazilian Army? Yes! Here you will find a simulation of our Royal Armed Forces! When you sign up, you become a Recruit and can even reach the rank of Commander!

🔥 We offer a variety of tools that bring the game closer to reality: weapons, armor, slate, handcuffs, military vehicles and much more! Additionally, as a soldier, you will participate in training, graduations, exams and commemorative marches!

💻 📱 Play Brazilian Army on almost any device!

⚠️ Check out some of the systems we have:

💥 Improved Combat System!
💥Amazing Air and Land Vehicles!
💥 Theft System in Jewelry Stores and Stations!
💥 Professions to acquire weapons!
